text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around the campus when I
hear a
familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And so, peace was restored throughout
the land.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The performance still feels a
little too
by-the-book.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah—Trainer. We've been asked to put
on a play
for the local children.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be a heroic legend, RPG-style!
We're
practicing hella hard!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since we've been put in charge, I want
to do a
good job, but it seems we've
played it too safe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Ooh! I know! At the end, I could do
a flyin'
body press!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I think not, El. Are you trying to
set a
dangerous example for the
children?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow! Okay, okay! I get it already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them continue their rehearsal
for some
time after.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Writing an entertaining script is
hard
work.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we simplify the lines a little
more?
Let's start again from the top.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Again?! Nggghhh... You sure are givin' it
your all,
Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course. The experiences children
have in their
formative years are
extremely important.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When I myself was young, I was always
moved
and inspired by the emphasis on
precision within
Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I want this play of ours to provoke the
same type
of response.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I want that too! I wanna
make 'em
feel like I did seein'
luchadores when I was little!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Then why don't we do another

read-through? Trainer, if you would play
the
antagonist...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their rehearsals continue every day until
the big
day of the show is here.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Argh... They don't call ya the Demon
Lord for
nothin'... Gotta hand it to ya...
That was a good
hit...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh! Don't give up! Beat that
Demon Lord
up!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... We cannot afford to lose. Too
many
people are counting on us.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: This is for them! Angelic Bolt!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah! Shrieking Condor Wave!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool! Next time something
scary
happens, I'm gonna be brave too!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I'm gonna be like a hero and
never lose!
Man, I wanna see that play
again!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Hehehe. Thank you. I'm
glad you
enjoyed the show.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Hehehe. Thank you. I'm
glad you
enjoyed the show.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and yours as well, Trainer. Thank
you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not only was your advice invaluable, but
your
performance as the antagonist is
what made our
play such a success.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Hey! Let's do that last part
together!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Okay! ...This is for them! Angel Bolt!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I guess it's our turn to watch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It can be our quest reward, like in a
video
game. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The children in the audience thoroughly
enjoyed
the play.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What? I would understand if this were a
concert,
but an encore for a play?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Pleeease! Encore! Encore!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Well, if you're going to insist.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Trainer? Shall we finish
strong
today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We perform the highlights one more
time, and the
curtain closes on a great
show.
